channel.title: With Raspberry Pi
channel.description: Master Raspberry Pi with our comprehensive tutorials covering setup, programming, troubleshooting, and advanced projects. Perfect for beginners and experts alike.

item.title: Raspberry Pi NetworkManager and nmcli: Setup and Troubleshooting
item.description: Fix and configure Raspberry Pi networking on OS Trixie with NetworkManager and nmcli. Diagnose Wi-Fi, Ethernet, static IP, DNS, routes, and SSH lockouts.

item.title: Tips & Advanced Techniques
item.description: Tips & Advanced Techniques. Follow practical Raspberry Pi setup steps, configuration examples, best practices, security guidance, and troubleshooting tips.

item.title: Google Chrome ARM64 .deb for Raspberry Pi: Install and Sync
item.description: Download and install google-chrome-stable_current_arm64.deb on 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS Trixie, verify ARM64, fix errors, and enable Google Sync safely.

item.title: Fix Google Chrome ARM64 Errors on Raspberry Pi
item.description: Fix Google Chrome ARM64 installation and startup errors on Raspberry Pi OS. Diagnose 404 downloads, armhf mismatch, APT dependencies, profiles, and Sync.

item.title: Update or Uninstall Google Chrome ARM64 on Raspberry Pi
item.description: Update, repair, or uninstall Google Chrome ARM64 on Raspberry Pi OS Trixie. Check APT repositories, preserve profiles, reinstall safely, or return to Chromium.

item.title: Raspberry Pi and Armbian ZRAM Setup, Benchmark, and Troubleshooting
item.description: Configure and benchmark ZRAM on Raspberry Pi OS Trixie or Armbian. Compare zram-tools, systemd-zram-generator, compression, PSI, latency, and OOM events.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Remote Desktop on Trixie: Connect, VNC, RDP, and SSH
item.description: Set up secure Raspberry Pi remote desktop on OS Trixie. Compare Connect, WayVNC, VNC, RDP, and SSH; fix headless displays, security, and slow sessions.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Temperature Command: Check CPU Heat and Throttling
item.description: Check Raspberry Pi CPU temperature with vcgencmd and thermal_zone0, detect throttling, configure Pi 5 cooling, log readings, and create practical alerts.

item.title: Raspberry Pi 5 NVMe Boot and PCIe Gen 3: Setup, Tests, and Recovery
item.description: Boot Raspberry Pi 5 from an NVMe SSD with an M.2 HAT+. Set EEPROM boot order, compare PCIe Gen 2 and Gen 3 safely, measure boot and storage, and recover errors.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Configuration Command: raspi-config Commands for Trixie (2026)
item.description: Use the Raspberry Pi configuration command, sudo raspi-config, on Raspberry Pi OS Trixie. Copy current SSH, I2C, SPI, hostname, boot, and Wi-Fi commands.

item.title: How to Set Up a Raspberry Pi in 2026: Imager, Wi-Fi, and SSH
item.description: Set up a Raspberry Pi in 2026 with Imager and Raspberry Pi OS Trixie. Configure Wi-Fi, username, SSH keys, headless boot, updates, and first checks safely.

item.title: Raspberry Pi User Guide: Complete Tutorials & Projects
item.description: Discover comprehensive Raspberry Pi tutorials, projects, and guides. Master programming, hardware setup, low-level assembly, OS development, and debugging.

item.title: AOSP & AAOS on Raspberry Pi
item.description: Build AOSP Android 16 and explore Android Automotive OS on Raspberry Pi 4 or Pi 5. Choose tablet, TV, or car targets and learn the platform architecture.

item.title: Android Architecture Map
item.description: Explore AOSP and AAOS architecture in an interactive map. Select Android framework, Binder, HAL, vendor, kernel, and Car Service components.

item.title: AOSP Architecture Explained: Apps, Binder, HAL, and Kernel
item.description: Understand AOSP architecture from apps to the Linux kernel. Learn System Server, Binder and AIDL, ART, HALs, Treble partitions, and AAOS Car Service.

item.title: Build AOSP Android 16 for Raspberry Pi 4 and Pi 5
item.description: Build AOSP Android 16 for Raspberry Pi 4 or Pi 5 with the Raspberry Vanilla local manifest. Select tablet, TV, or AAOS products and create a test image safely.

item.title: Run Android Automotive OS on Raspberry Pi
item.description: Run the Android Automotive OS AOSP car product on Raspberry Pi 4 or Pi 5 for safe platform learning. Build, boot, inspect logs, and understand VHAL boundaries.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Benchmark Methodology: Power, Temperature, Storage, Network, and AI
item.description: Benchmark Pi power, temperature, boot time, storage, network, and AI reproducibly. Capture hardware and software context, raw data, and failure states.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Boot Time Optimization with systemd
item.description: Reduce Raspberry Pi boot time safely with systemd-analyze. Find critical services, test each change, compare results, and recover from failed optimizations.

item.title: Raspberry Pi OS Trixie Security Hardening 2026
item.description: Harden Raspberry Pi OS Trixie with updates, sudo passwords, SSH keys, UFW, least privilege, automatic upgrades, logging, backups, and tested recovery.
